title: Puppet Master Remote Access System contracts
description: Canonical Remote Access System owner contracts after the September 1 Go tsnet connector supersession: durable routes and migrations; PM-owned signed pm-tailnet-connector configuration, state, authenticated versioned IPC, Server-owned authorization handoff, private endpoint, bounded native egress, hosted Funnel, security, receipts, migration, external-host coexistence, and backup exclusion; plus the exact 44-primary/eight-alias owner census and all unaffected reverse-proxy, Remote Link, callback, lifecycle, ObservableWork, and exact-return contracts. The former full-install/Serve route configuration is retained only as an explicit migration reader. Static schemas and fixtures do not prove central registration, native handlers, Event Authority admission, package contents, WAN/E2E behavior, persistence execution, runtime, visuals, security effectiveness, or readiness.

remote_route_migration_record.title: RemoteRouteMigrationRecord
x-semantic-invariants: phase=complete implies observed Server/endpoint/route generations equal their expected values
identity_fence_status=matched_existing_server and currentness_fence_status=expected_generations_current are runtime assertions requiring durable evidence refs

remote_route_migration_receipt.title: RemoteRouteMigrationReceipt
x-semantic-invariants: terminal_status=complete requires the identity_fence_ref and currentness_fence_ref to bind the exact migration_id, server_id, endpoint IDs, and route IDs
schema validation does not independently prove the referenced runtime comparison

legacy_tailscale_route_configuration_mig.title: LegacyTailscaleRouteConfigurationMigrationReader
legacy_tailscale_route_configuration_mig.description: Migration-reader-only shape for pre-RAS-015 serialized full-install, Serve, and host-reuse records. It is intentionally excluded from the aggregate root oneOf and cannot authorize current configuration, capability, health, discovery, dispatch, or host-state ingestion.

tailscale_authorization_session.title: TailscaleAuthorizationSession
tailscale_authorization_session.description: Durable Server-owned hosted authorization metadata. Authorization URLs are one-time protected actions and are never persisted as reusable URL values.

public_ingress_security_policy.title: PublicIngressSecurityPolicy
x-semantic-invariants: hosted_tailscale_funnel requires separately persisted explicit_consent_ref and preflight_receipt_ref
consent_generation, preflight_generation, policy_generation, and route generation must be checked for current exact activation at runtime
schema acceptance is not evidence that the public preflight ran or passed

hosted_tailscale_auth_handoff_record.title: HostedTailscaleAuthHandoffRecord
hosted_tailscale_auth_handoff_record.description: Migration-reader-only shape for the pre-RAS-015 initiating-active-Client lifetime fence. Current hosted authorization uses tailscale_authorization_session and a newly authorized handoff after Client loss.
x-semantic-invariants: authentication_operation_id is the sole operation identity; returned_operation_id is forbidden
initiating_client_id is the sole Client identity; fallback_client_id is forbidden
exact_operation_and_initiating_active_client is a runtime fence assertion requiring current operation and Client-session evidence
